text.16:57: And they assign unto Allah daughters - Be He Glorified! - and unto themselves what they desire;
text.21:102: They will not hear the slightest sound thereof, while they abide in that which their souls desire.
text.34:54: And a gulf is set between them and that which they desire, as was done for people of their kind of old. Lo! they were in hopeless doubt.
text.41:31: We are your protecting friends in the life of the world and in the Hereafter. There ye will have (all) that your souls desire, and there ye will have (all) for which ye pray.
text.43:71: Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein.
text.52:22: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
text.56:21: And flesh of fowls that they desire.
text.77:42: And fruits such as they desire.
